messages:
Ethan: Heads-up — ‘Deck Gauntlet’ tomorrow night 7pm in lounge. Quick rotating rounds on Steam Deck/PC/Console. Bring controllers and spare batteries.
Ethan: Set the vibe: fast matches, low-stress, occasional chaos.
Priya: I can bring a Steam Deck + dock adapter. Also have an extra 65W USB-C charger.
Nora: Bringing a PS5 pad and my little LED lamp for ambience.
Zach: I can bring my gaming laptop + ethernet if someone wants a low-lat host.
Megan: Snacks? I vote for fruit + granola bars over chips (less greasy controllers).
Ethan: Agree on less greasy. Allergies?
Nora: No shellfish, otherwise fine.
Zach: Peanut-free please, Im allergic.
Priya: Noted  Ill swap to trail mix without nuts and bring bottled water.
Megan: Anyone have a capture card? I want to record the weirdest plays.
Zach: I have an Elgato HD60 S+, can bring it but need USB3 port.
Ethan: Perfect. Also can someone bring a long HDMI and an HDMI->USB-C adapter for the Deck dock?
Priya: Ill bring a short HDMI and an adapter. If we need long cable I can pick one up.
Nora: Wi-Fi check: last time the lounge was flaky. Would love an ethernet run from the router.
infra-bot: Reminder: temporary ethernet patch panel on floor 3 is available 18:45-20:30. Reserve via infra request.
Zach: Ill request the patch and bring a 10ft Cat6.
Ethan: Format idea: 20-minute gauntlet blocks. Rotate hosts so everyone gets a try. Winners get a silly sticker.
Priya: Can we also do a 2v2 for one round? Mix Deck + controller setups.
Megan: In for 2v2. Ill captain snack procurement and bring premade veggie trays.
Nora: Also can someone bring a folding table for the controllers and snacks (no spills on sofas)?
Zach: I can bring a spare folding table.
Ethan: Signups: drop emoji for 7pm slot. Drop :video_game: if you're coming, :sos: if youre late.
Priya: :video_game:
Nora: :video_game:
Zach: :video_game:
Megan: :sos: (arrive ~7:30)
Ethan: Cool. Quick note: label controllers and charge batteries before bringing. Last time the battery scramble was real.
Megan: Will label and bring tiny velcro cable ties for chargers.
Ethan: See you tomorrow. Bring folks, bring good trash-talk (gentle), and maybe a ridiculous hat for the sticker ceremony. :joystick:
